changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate/typo dataset name 'DI-ALOCONAN'. Consolidated model variants (T5 base, T5 2m, T5 1m) under 'T5'. Simplified output descriptions to one comprehensive description.
Removed redundant metric descriptions. Normalized 'Repetition Rate (RR)' to 'Repetition Rate' and 'Turns swap' to 'Turn swap' for consistency.
Removed placeholder 'None' values as no LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted.

guideline: Annotators post-edited machine-generated dialogues to make them natural while keeping seed dataset as reference

Session-specific guidelines: Session 1 - edit HS to align with previous CN, allow turn swaps/deletions; Session 2 - keep HS unchanged, edit CN for novelty, no turn swaps/deletions; Session 3 - verify factual statements, check target consistency

changes_made.explanation: Added missing expert evaluation. Removed automatic metrics ('turn deletion', 'turn swap', 'HTER') from human criteria as they are efficiency metrics, not evaluation criteria. Normalized 'veracity of fact-based statements' to 'Factual correctness'.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on dataset creation through human-machine collaboration for dialogue generation in hate speech countering. It uses both automatic metrics and human evaluation, but no LLM-as-judge approach. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some normalization and removal of redundant/incorrect items.
